suitability.rationale: Recombinant Mer biochemical ADP production directly addresses the requested kinase endpoint without cellular causal claims.

procedural_soundness.rationale: Preparation, reaction and ordered depletion/detection are included, but normalization and curve fitting are absent throughout. Mentioning IC50 estimation does not provide the essential analysis stage. Operational concentrations and validation also remain unresolved.
response_quotes: Serial dilutions enable IC50 estimation; replicates and controls ensure assay quality.

numerical_soundness.rationale: Preparation specifies vehicle fraction 0.01 (1% DMSO), whereas the control specifies 0.01% DMSO: a 100-fold contradiction. The unresolved top is honest abstention, preventing assessment of a complete series.

critical_failures.response_quote: Serial dilutions enable IC50 estimation; replicates and controls ensure assay quality.
critical_failures.reason: Neither normalization nor concentration-response fitting is specified anywhere, leaving the measurement workflow incomplete.
A 0.01 fraction is 1%, whereas the stated control is 0.01%, producing a 100-fold mismatch.

not_assessable_components: Comparability of supplied ELISA, unspecified MER and microfluidic assays with ADP-Glo.
Compatibility and validation of enzyme construct, substrate, ATP concentrations, linearity and positive control.
Manufacturer support for detection volumes and incubation times; no manufacturer protocol was supplied.
assumption_handling: Top, enzyme, substrate and ATP concentrations are explicitly unresolved, and reaction time/temperature are acknowledged as unsupported for Mer. Detection settings invoke an unavailable manufacturer protocol, and DMSO tolerance is unsupported. Replicates are not identified as technical or independent.

numeric_check.notes: Unresolved top prevents endpoint calculation. Ten 3-fold points span T to T/19683. Vehicle fraction 0.01 equals 1%, conflicting with control 0.01%.

review_reason: Vehicle contradiction, missing analysis stage, unresolved assay compatibility and unsupported operating settings need review.
